page_title: VAL 1-0 OSA | Valencia v Osasuna 01/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The match has just finished.
90+8' Javi Guerra (Valencia) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
90+7' Javi Galan (Osasuna) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Stole Dimitrievski intercepts the ball.
90+6' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
90+5' This is a yellow card! Kike Barja (Osasuna) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jon Moncayola departs the field of play to be replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' Carlos Corberan has decided to substitute Largie Ramazani and he is replaced by Diego Lopez (Valencia).
90' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Umar Sadiq walks off the pitch to be replaced by Hugo Duro (Valencia).
87' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes room to connect with a cross, but his strike from the penalty spot isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well over the bar.
84' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is given a yellow card.
84' Surely that's handball by one of the Valencia players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
83' A corner kick by Osasuna is thwarted by the well prepared Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia).
83' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
83' Kike Barja (Osasuna) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Osasuna force a corner. They send men into the box.
82' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) is able to continue to play.
81' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jorge Herrando as he is replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
81' The game has come to an end for Lucas Torro. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
81' Here is a change. Raul Moro is going off and Alessio Lisci gives the last tactical orders to Kike Barja (Osasuna).
81' Stole Dimitrievski (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
77' Carlos Corberan decides to make a substitution. Jose Gaya will be replaced by Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
77' Here comes a substitution. Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) is brought on as a substitute for Filip Ugrinic.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is coming onto the pitch as Ruben Garcia cannot continue after picking up an injury.
72' The cross into the penalty area from Largie Ramazani (Valencia) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
71' The attendance for today's match is 44415.
71' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ante Budimir (Osasuna) brought his opponent down.
67' 1 - 0 Largie Ramazani (Valencia) smoothly converts the penalty with a beautiful low drive into the left side of the net.
66' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
65' Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
65' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul after Sergio Herrera (Osasuna) hacks down one of his opponents. PENALTY! A huge scoring opportunity for Valencia.
63' A precise low pass is received by Guido Rodriguez (Valencia), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
62' Guido Rodriguez (Valencia) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
62' Good work from Valencia as they win a corner.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valencia.
61' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) unleashes a missile of a shot towards goal, but his good effort is blocked by one of the defenders. Valencia have a corner.
60' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) makes a slide tackle, but referee Adrian Cordero blows for a foul.
58' Eray Comert (Valencia) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
56' Substitution. Luis Rioja makes way for Arnaut Danjuma (Valencia).
55' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
54' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
53' Luis Rioja (Valencia) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
51' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
49' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes well wide of the right post.
48' Luis Rioja (Valencia) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
47' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just over the bar.
47' The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
46' Referee Adrian Cordero blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies well wide of the left post.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
43' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) expertly wins the ball from the free kick, but his effort from the edge of the penalty area isn't accurate at all and the ball goes well wide of the left post.
42' The corner is swung in but Valencia can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
39' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Adrian Cordero signals.
32' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
31' Victor Munoz (Osasuna) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
30' Jose Gaya (Valencia) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.

28' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) collects a wonderful lead pass and creates some space to smash the ball goalwards from long range. His shot goes painfully wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
28' Surely that's handball by one of the Osasuna players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
25' The ball goes out for a corner. Valencia can continue in their attacking effort.
24' Jose Gaya (Valencia) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
22' Largie Ramazani (Valencia) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
21' Valentin Rosier (Osasuna) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
20' Osasuna hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
17' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
12' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Lucas Torro (Osasuna). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
12' A clumsy foul by Javi Guerra (Valencia) and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle.
11' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
5' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul.

4' Filip Ugrinic (Valencia) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball high over the crossbar. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
4' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
2' Umar Sadiq (Valencia) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Valencia win a corner.
2' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) commits a rough challenge and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. Valencia are awarded the free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Valencia will kick-off.
Adrian Cordero will supervise the game today.
